I've replied to Tobias in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the ticket is **#8841**.

It comes from his own message in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27), a channel he's in. He was answering Hollis's question about his dealer account and said West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, so he flagged it on #8841 for support.

That message says "Tobias's dealer account" and never names Marrow Fieldworks. An older note says Marrow Fieldworks, then Pree's dealer account, was changing hands in January 2026, which points to it being his account now. I'm not certain, so I asked him to check before he puts it in the weekly notes. A ticket number is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to post in that channel.
